decisions.reason: The source changes the displayed prices for predefined bundles; it does not resume or modify the deferred instant quote calculator or its calculation rules.
The candidate governs presentation and selection of individual services, while the source changes only bundle price displays by square-footage range.
Varying bundle prices by square-footage range does not change the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The bundle pricing display decision does not affect gallery category tabs or the optional other-photography area.
The source contains no change to gallery hover animations or their scope.
Changing detailed bundle pricing content does not alter the homepage control that links users to detailed pricing information.
The source does not affect the homepage hero image emphasis, overlay color, opacity, or effect.
The bundle pricing display change does not alter the requirement for representative imagery accompanying each service.
The source changes pricing information rather than the site's image-focused presentation style.
The source does not change interactive gallery scrolling or any other gallery browsing behavior.
